recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-31400 unless the work group opens a separate compatibility-policy or ElementDefinition.condition cleanup issue.
issue_request: FHIR-31400 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked that eld-1 stop applying to differentials and apply only to snapshots, with related compatibility text changes allowing constraint relaxation.
initial_application: HL7/fhir PR #1700, merged as 05c1368fca9b665e75c1fb2f62a37a9c4e90690b, applied the change by adding the former eld-1 rule to source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-StructureDefinition.xml under StructureDefinition.snapshot.element and updating source/versions.html.
additional_context: The originating Zulip discussion and FHIR-I WGM minutes support the snapshot-only scope. The implementation Zulip thread records that the final location was changed to snapshot.element after build feedback. Later published decisions explain current differences: FHIR-37692 renamed the applied invariant from sdf-24 to sdf-28, and FHIR-36755 refined the versions.html compatibility text.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current build-scope StructureDefinition source contains sdf-28 on StructureDefinition.snapshot.element with the discriminator-or-description expression; current ElementDefinition spreadsheet source no longer contains eld-1 or that discriminator invariant; and current versions.html text covers non-invalidating constraint changes after FHIR-36755.
